dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High visual prominence with sharp, thin pale boundaries outlining dark feather centers on folded primaries and secondaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct transition boundary where fine, dense horizontal barring on the nape meets larger, broad scalloped patterns on the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Fine, high-contrast horizontal black-and-buff barring covering the entire crown and posterior neck.
